verdict.rationale: Docs show skill installation is fundamentally just creating a SKILL.md file/folder in a skills directory (anthropic-skills-docs-1, anthropic-skills-gh-3, anthropic-skills-docs-26), which an agent could do headlessly via filesystem writes, and the Skills API allows programmatic upload/management without human interaction (anthropic-skills-docs-24, anthropic-skills-docs-39, anthropic-skills-docs-10). However, the primary distribution path (plugin marketplaces) is documented via interactive slash commands like `/plugin marketplace add` and `/plugin install` (anthropic-skills-docs-9, anthropic-skills-gh-1, anthropic-skills-gh-4) with no documented non-interactive/CLI flag for scripted, promptless installs in an agent-driven headless run. Missing for 10: an explicit headless/non-interactive CLI install command or flag (vs. interactive slash commands), and confirmation that plugin marketplace installs work end-to-end without any prompt in a fully automated agent loop.
